user_intent.original_question: 找出合作 3 次以上的导演-演员组合，且他们合作电影的平均评分 >= 7.5。请返回导演名、演员名、合作次数、合作电影的平均评分。

business_rules.name: 评分可信度
business_rules.condition: num_votes > 10000 推荐用于排名类查询

historical_qa_pairs.original_question: 导演-演员黄金搭档分析，找出合作 3 次以上且合作作品平均评分 >= 7.5 的导演-演员组合
historical_qa_pairs.sql: SELECT d.primary_name AS director_name, a.primary_name AS actor_name, COUNT(*) AS collaboration_count, ROUND(AVG(t.average_rating), 2) AS avg_rating FROM principals pd JOIN titles t ON pd.title_id = t.id AND t.title_type = 'movie' JOIN principals pa ON pa.title_id = t.id AND pa.category_id IN ('actor', 'actress') JOIN names d ON pd.name_id = d.id JOIN names a ON pa.name_id = a.id WHERE pd.category_id = 'director' AND t.num_votes > 5000 AND t.average_rating IS NOT NULL GROUP BY d.id, d.primary_name, a.id, a.primary_name HAVING COUNT(*) >= 3 AND AVG(t.average_rating) >= 7.5 ORDER BY collaboration_count DESC, avg_rating DESC LIMIT 20

knowledge.content: titles ←→ principals ←→ names 核心路径
查询演员时必须同时包含 category_id IN ('actor', 'actress')
导演的 category_id = 'director'，不要用 job_id 查导演
